Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Added "Export all settings" at the top of /fur. It copies your settings and what the plugin sees (time of day, weather, zone, the game's graphics options, your GPU, loaded plugins, and add-ons such as ReShade) to the clipboard. Paste it when you report a problem.
